characters.name: Jason Duval
characters.summary: Grew up around grifters and crooks, served in the Army, and later worked for local drug runners in the Keys. His connection with Lucia changes the stakes.

characters.name: Lucia Caminos
characters.summary: Fresh out of the Leonida Penitentiary, Lucia is determined to change her circumstances and build the life her mother dreamed of.

characters.name: Cal Hampton
characters.summary: Jason’s friend and an associate of Brian. He feels safest at home, monitoring Coast Guard communications and online chatter.

characters.name: Boobie Ike
characters.summary: A Vice City local with a business empire spanning real estate, a club and a recording studio. He works with Dre’Quan Priest.

characters.name: Dre’Quan Priest
characters.summary: An aspiring music figure focused on building Only Raw Records and breaking into the Vice City music scene.

characters.name: Real Dimez
characters.summary: Bae-Luxe and Roxy are longtime friends who use music and social media to build a following. They are signed to Only Raw Records.

characters.name: Raul Bautista
characters.summary: A confident, experienced bank robber who looks for people willing to take big risks for big rewards.

characters.name: Brian Heder
characters.summary: A veteran smuggler who operates through a boat yard in the Keys and lets others handle much of the risk.

guides.title: First hours in Leonida: a spoiler-light checklist
guides.summary: A practical checklist for settings, exploration, saving and learning the map. Update the steps only after testing the final game.
guides.body: Start with the control layout and accessibility options. Explore at your own pace, note important locations, and avoid assuming that GTA V systems work identically in GTA VI.

guides.title: Driving, vehicle classes and road awareness
guides.summary: A field guide template for vehicle classes, handling notes, repair options and driving techniques.
guides.body: Record the vehicle, class, conditions, upgrades and test method whenever comparing handling or speed. Do not publish exact performance numbers without repeatable tests.

guides.title: Money and progression tracker
guides.summary: Track confirmed activities, rewards, costs and progression requirements as players discover them.
guides.body: For each earning method, record mission/activity name, time required, payout, repeatability and any prerequisites. Flag exploits separately and re-test after patches.

guides.title: Police pursuit survival guide
guides.summary: A guide framework for pursuit tactics, line-of-sight rules and wanted-level behaviour.
guides.body: Add only mechanics observed in-game. Separate story mission rules from free-roam rules and note platform-specific controls.

guides.title: Leonida exploration and collectibles checklist
guides.summary: A spoiler-aware checklist for locations, side activities, collectibles and points of interest.
guides.body: Each location should carry a screenshot or clear landmark, map pin, region, source and confirmation status before being marked verified.

guides.title: 100% completion tracker
guides.summary: Build a checklist for story missions, side content, activities and collectibles once the final requirements are known.
guides.body: Do not invent completion requirements. Add each item only after checking the in-game statistics or a reproducible save-file test.
